events.title: Live Music Fridays @ Kings Beach Tavern
events.description: Enjoy a night of free live music featuring local artists at the Kings Beach Tavern, a popular spot for casual drinks and a relaxed atmosphere. It's a regular Friday night fixture, ideal for a laid-back social evening.

events.title: NightQuarter (Friday)
events.description: Experience NightQuarter, a vibrant entertainment precinct offering live music from various local and touring artists, street food, and unique market stalls in a lively, community-oriented atmosphere. It's an ongoing event series with a diverse program.

events.title: Friday Night Live Music (Pat Nicholson)
events.description: Listen to live music from Pat Nicholson in a relaxed club setting at Mooloolaba, offering a casual evening of tunes in a community-focused venue. Great for a relaxed Friday night catch-up.

events.title: Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer
events.description: Immerse yourself in a captivating tribute to Hans Zimmer's iconic film scores, performed by a live string quartet in an intimate, candlelit setting. This atmospheric concert provides a unique, artistic listening experience.

events.title: Candlelight: Tribute to Fleetwood Mac
events.description: Enjoy a tribute to the legendary Fleetwood Mac, with their classic hits reimagined and performed by a live string quartet under the glow of candlelight. An intimate and artistically unique musical experience.

events.title: BRIT FEST featuring OASIS - COLDPLAY - ROBBIE WILLIAMS - BLUR - MADNESS - THE JAM
events.description: Celebrate the best of British rock with tribute acts covering iconic bands like Oasis, Coldplay, and Blur, promising a high-energy night of anthems. Held at a dedicated music venue, it's a great event for fans of the genre.

events.title: ALLORA "Camera Shy" TOUR
events.description: Catch indie band ALLORA on their 'Camera Shy' tour in Nambour, offering a chance to see emerging artists in a local setting. Perfect for those seeking intimate gigs and authentic new music.

events.title: Christmas in July Bush Dance
events.description: Join a festive Christmas in July Bush Dance with live music from the 'All In' band, offering a fun, interactive, and social evening of traditional Australian folk dancing. Great for community connection and active participation.

events.title: Rogue Traders “THE ANTHEMS” 21st Anniversary Tour
events.description: Celebrate 21 years of Rogue Traders with their 'THE ANTHEMS' tour, playing their biggest hits live at Kings Beach Tavern. Expect a high-energy performance from this iconic Australian act.

events.title: Live Music Saturdays @ 4 Pines Mooloolaba
events.description: Enjoy free live music on Saturday evenings at 4 Pines Mooloolaba, a popular brewery known for its craft beers and relaxed, social atmosphere. A great option for a casual night out with friends.

events.title: NightQuarter (Saturday)
events.description: NightQuarter provides a dynamic weekend experience with diverse live music acts, artisanal food, and boutique market stalls. It's a large, lively hub with a community feel that supports local artists and businesses.

events.title: Ministry of Sound Testament - 90s Session
events.description: Step back in time with Ministry of Sound's 90s session, featuring iconic dance tracks from the decade in a vibrant day-party atmosphere. It's a themed event perfect for those who enjoy classic electronic and dance music.

events.title: Yacht Rock Revival - Caloundra
events.description: Enjoy an afternoon of smooth sounds with the Yacht Rock Revival band, performing classic hits from the 70s and 80s soft rock era. A perfect laid-back Sunday session for fans of the genre.

events.title: Live Music @ The Surf Club Mooloolaba
events.description: Relax by the beach with live music at The Surf Club Mooloolaba, offering a casual afternoon of tunes in a community-friendly venue. Enjoy the ocean views and a laid-back Sunday vibe.

events.title: Noosa Alive! Festival
events.description: Explore the Noosa Alive! Festival, a week-long celebration of arts and culture featuring a diverse program of live music, theatre, literary events, and visual arts across various venues. This festival offers a rich array of stimulating creative experiences.

events.title: Sunny Coast Blues Jam with The Aitken Br...
events.description: Join The Aitken Brothers for a lively blues jam session, an open invitation for musicians and enthusiasts to share their passion for blues music. This is a highly social and interactive event for the local music community.
